title: Cloned BNB officer: KYC threat
description: A cloned 'bank officer' voice calls over VoIP, threatens account closure and demands the OTP. Rule R1 fires regardless of what any detector says.

segments.text: Hello, main Bharat National Bank ke security department se bol raha hoon.
Aapka KYC expire ho gaya hai aur aapka account aaj band ho jayega.
Account bachane ke liye abhi turant apna OTP batao jo aapke phone par aaya hai.
Yeh baat kisi ko mat batana, warna account block ho jayega.
